How It Works

4 Stages of a Monitoring Programme

One crack photo tells you nothing. A series of dated readings tells you everything

1

Assessment & Point Selection

We assess the cracks and select monitoring positions that will actually show movement

2

Installation & Baseline

Gauges installed and the first baseline readings recorded and dated

3

Periodic Readings

Readings taken at agreed intervals — weekly, monthly or tied to the works programme

4

Trend Analysis & Alert

Movement charted over time; you are alerted immediately if readings accelerate

Movement Classification

Every Reading Classified

You will always know which category your building falls into — and what it means

Stable

No measurable change across the monitoring period

Slight Movement

Small variation consistent with thermal or seasonal effects

Active Movement

Consistent directional movement — investigation recommended

Critical

Rapid movement — immediate engineer referral and action
